# Transfer of an acceptance threshold across two education systems

Can the calibrated confidence cutoff travel between the earlier OULAD four-class day-60 task and the Portuguese three-class enrollment task? Exchange only the archived acceptance thresholds. Keep the original recipient classifier, scores, argmax labels and locally calibrated rerouting rule frozen. For each recipient compare local calibration, the foreign cutoff, and full coverage. Compare both label rules on exactly the accepted rows and report how many reviews move, how many of those argmax labels are wrong, coverage and accepted error. Report paired changes in coverage and selective error (foreign minus local) with two-sided learner-cluster bootstrap intervals using 2,000 draws, seed 20261122, Bonferroni across the two endpoints in each of two directions. All records with equal confidence receive the same action. Reproduce archived local selections before scoring transfer. No threshold is tuned here. This is a secondary operational sensitivity check on previously evaluated records. The estimand is transport of the scalar cutoff between two locally fitted systems with different targets and numbers of classes. These data cannot estimate transfer of the underlying classifier or day-60 registry delays. No practical portability margin was registered.
